comments.text: Nguyễn Văn Duy Update: Smarter task assignment in #ClawTask with #OpenClaw Assigning tasks on desktop is easy, but doing it on mobile? Not ideal. So I made it possible to assign tasks directly in chat. You just pick one agent as a manager — it handles task creation and distributes work to other agents based on expertise. Currently supports one manager at a time for better control. If you're using ClawTask, try it out — it might surprise you how well it organizes things
